title: Cart datastore crash (valkey-cart process killed)
hypothesis: If the valkey-cart process crashes, only the cart and checkout journeys degrade; Docker's restart policy restores valkey-cart within seconds without human action; all other journeys stay within baseline; carts created before the crash are still intact afterwards.
why: valkey-cart is the only store of shopping-cart state and sits on the two highest-value journeys (checkout weight 1.0, cart 0.8). It runs with a 20 MB memory limit, so an OOM-kill is a realistic crash, and the static map shows it has no data volume.
